# Creatures present in our game

*Generated by `ShardContent/tools/cosmetic-catalog/speciesingame.py` from the shard's own era-reviewed Felucca spawn data (`Alpha2b/Spawns/*.json`). Owner rule, 2026-10-08: **a monster figurine is fine as long as the creature it shows is present in our game.***

A creature counts as present when one of those spawners places it (149 creature types; vendors, guild masters, reagents, crops, chests and camp markers are excluded). A creature that exists in the code but is never spawned (for example the mountain goat; the world has only goats) does not count until it is spawned. The catalog validator checks every figurine's `monster:` tag against this list.
